events.title: Live 10-25 2PM EDT: Tower And Dragon Demo+Map Editor+Boss
events.summary: I'm going to walk through playing the demo as well as attempting to take out the ogre boss on the full version of the game.Additionally, I'm going to demo the zone editor for how I built zone zero.The demo will last about 20-45 minutes.Travel back to 1977. What could possibly be built with only 8192 bytes of RAM? This game goes back to where my programming journey began in 1977. It redefines what is possible.The game is written in 100% 6502 assembly language. The map editor was written in BASIC
